name: mla_prefill_varlen_n_heads12_qk_head_dim192_v_head_dim128
description: MLA's prefill attention once kv_b has expanded the latent keys, every head on its own: sequence s's queries are q's rows cu_seqlens_q[s]:cu_seqlens_q[s + 1], its keys and values the rows cu_seqlens_k[s]:cu_seqlens_k[s + 1] of k and v (with no prefix, the queries' own rows). Causal, aligned at the end: query i of a sequence of Lq queries over Lk keys reads keys 0 .. Lk - Lq + i. Logits q . k * sm_scale over qk_head_dim; output the softmax-weighted sum of v. With qkv_fp8 a kernel may round q, k and v to float8_e4m3fn first, as aiter's fp8 prefill does.

n_q.description: Query rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_kv.description: Key and value rows, every sequence's back to back.

n_heads.description: Heads on this rank; k and v carry q's.

qk_head_dim.description: Values per q and k head: the no-rope and rope parts.

v_head_dim.description: Values per v and output head.

cu_seqlens_q.description: Where each sequence's queries start in q, then where the last ends.

output.description: The softmax-weighted sum of the values each query reads.

sources.content:
"""MLA prefill attention, causal, every head on its own, routed by shape.

One sequence of at most ``_SHORT_MAX_ROWS`` rows runs on the FlyDSL short-sequence kernel (``short_attn``).

One sequence of at least ``_FP8_MIN_ROWS`` rows runs on aiter's fp8 assembly MLA prefill
(``mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd``, qk 192 / v 128) after q, k and v are rounded to float8_e4m3fn in one FlyDSL
launch (``qkv_fp8``), as the contract allows. Its persistent work list is built here per shape instead of by
aiter's planner: one item per (head, 256-row query tile) walking the tile's causal key range, dealt longest
first to the least loaded CU with a key-length plus fixed cost model, then rebalanced by moves and swaps.
Where the longest CU load is far above the mean, the longest walks are split into key pieces that write fp32
partials, and a FlyDSL launch (``split_merge``) merges them.

Any other single sequence runs on aiter's gfx950 assembly forward (``fmha_v3_varlen_fwd``, 128-row Q tiles) in
group mode, one group per 128-row Q block: group ``g`` holds the block's queries over keys ``[0, end of
block)``, causal aligned at the end, which is the block's own causal walk. Groups are ordered longest first,
and when one group per block would need more than one round of workgroups the shortest blocks are paired into
256-row groups, which the kernel's head/tail merge runs as one workgroup. The groups' real lengths and
physical row offsets are shape constants, since a single sequence starts at row 0.
"""

import functools
import heapq

import torch

from .qkv_fp8 import launcher as to_fp8
from .short_attn import launcher as short_attn
from .split_merge import descriptors, merge

_ONE_ROUND_WG = 256

# longest single sequence run on the FlyDSL short-sequence kernel
_SHORT_MAX_ROWS = 1024

_V3_BLOCK = 128
_V3_MAX_BLOCKS = 24
# 128-row blocks paired into one group, smallest first, when one group per block exceeds a round
_V3_PAIRS_OVER_ROUND = 4


# plans kept per shape: a forward's layers share one, and serving sees new lengths without end
_PLANS_KEPT = 64


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=_PLANS_KEPT)
def _v3_plan(n_q: int, n_heads: int, n_offsets: int, device):
    """For one short sequence: the per-block groups' real offsets, their physical offsets relative to the
    sequence start, and the longest group; ``None`` otherwise."""
    if n_offsets != 2:
        return None
    n_blocks = -(-n_q // _V3_BLOCK)
    if n_blocks > _V3_MAX_BLOCKS:
        return None
    bounds = [min(_V3_BLOCK * i, n_q) for i in range(n_blocks + 1)]
    pairs = _V3_PAIRS_OVER_ROUND if n_blocks * n_heads > _ONE_ROUND_WG else 0
    pairs = min(pairs, n_blocks // 2)
    groups = [(bounds[2 * p], bounds[2 * p + 2]) for p in range(pairs)]
    groups += [(bounds[j], bounds[j + 1]) for j in range(2 * pairs, n_blocks)]
    groups.sort(key=lambda g: -g[1])
    seqstart_q, seqstart_k = [0], [0]
    for r0, r1 in groups:
        seqstart_q.append(seqstart_q[-1] + r1 - r0)
        seqstart_k.append(seqstart_k[-1] + r1)
    # physical offsets: a single sequence always starts at row 0 (the offsets' first entry is 0)
    as_tensor = functools.partial(torch.tensor, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    return (
        as_tensor(seqstart_q),
        as_tensor(seqstart_k),
        as_tensor([r0 for r0, _ in groups] + [n_q]),
        as_tensor([0] * len(groups) + [n_q]),
        max(r1 - r0 for r0, r1 in groups),
    )


_FP8_TILE = 256  # the fp8 assembly prefill's query rows per work item
_FP8_KV_UNIT = 128  # keys per unit of a work item's cost
_FP8_WORK_COST = 1.0  # a work item's fixed cost, in key units
_FP8_MIN_ROWS = 2048  # shortest single sequence run on the fp8 path
# split the key walks when the longest CU load exceeds this many times the mean
_SPLIT_IMBALANCE = 1.5


def _rebalance(bins, loads, eps=1e-9):
    """Lower the busiest CU's load by moving one of its items to another CU, or swapping it for a smaller one,
    while either step leaves both CUs below the old maximum; the step taken is the one with the lowest new
    pair maximum."""
    while True:
        m = max(range(len(bins)), key=lambda c: (loads[c], -c))
        best = None
        for i, a in enumerate(bins[m]):
            for c in range(len(bins)):
                if c == m:
                    continue
                if loads[c] + a[0] < loads[m] - eps:
                    cand = (max(loads[m] - a[0], loads[c] + a[0]), i, c, None)
                    if best is None or cand[0] < best[0] - eps:
                        best = cand
                for j, b in enumerate(bins[c]):
                    d = a[0] - b[0]
                    if d > eps and loads[c] + d < loads[m] - eps:
                        cand = (max(loads[m] - d, loads[c] + d), i, c, j)
                        if best is None or cand[0] < best[0] - eps:
                            best = cand
        if best is None:
            return
        _, i, c, j = best
        a = bins[m][i]
        if j is None:
            bins[m].pop(i)
            bins[c].append(a)
            loads[m] -= a[0]
            loads[c] += a[0]
        else:
            b = bins[c][j]
            bins[m][i], bins[c][j] = b, a
            loads[m] -= a[0] - b[0]
            loads[c] += a[0] - b[0]


def _fp8_deal(n_q: int, n_heads: int, n_cu: int, max_units):
    """Each (head, 256-row query tile) walks its causal key range whole, or, past ``max_units`` key units, in
    near-equal 128-key-aligned pieces that write partial outputs (one partial slot per piece, shared by the
    heads); items are dealt longest first to the least loaded CU, then rebalanced. Returns the per-CU items
    and loads, the slot count and the split tiles as ``(first row, rows, slots)``."""
    items, merges = [], []
    n_slots = 0
    for j in range(-(-n_q // _FP8_TILE)):
        r0, r1 = j * _FP8_TILE, min(j * _FP8_TILE + _FP8_TILE, n_q)
        units = -(-r1 // _FP8_KV_UNIT)
        pieces = 1 if max_units is None else -(-units // max_units)
        bounds = [min(round(units * p / pieces) * _FP8_KV_UNIT, r1) for p in range(pieces + 1)]
        slots = [-1] if pieces == 1 else list(range(n_slots, n_slots + pieces))
        if pieces > 1:
            n_slots += pieces
            merges.append((r0, r1 - r0, tuple(slots)))
        for h in range(n_heads):
            for k0, k1, slot in zip(bounds, bounds[1:], slots):
                items.append(((k1 - k0) / _FP8_KV_UNIT + _FP8_WORK_COST, h, r0, r1, k0, k1, slot))
    items.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2], t[4]))
    heap = [(0.0, c) for c in range(n_cu)]
    bins = [[] for _ in range(n_cu)]
    loads = [0.0] * n_cu
    for item in items:
        load, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        bins[c].append(item)
        loads[c] = load + item[0]
        heapq.heappush(heap, (loads[c], c))
    _rebalance(bins, loads)
    return bins, loads, n_slots, tuple(merges)


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=_PLANS_KEPT)
def _fp8_plan(n_q: int, n_heads: int, n_offsets: int, device):
    """For one sequence of at least ``_FP8_MIN_ROWS`` rows: the fp8 prefill's work list, with the key walks
    split (``_fp8_deal``) only when the longest unsplit CU load exceeds ``_SPLIT_IMBALANCE`` times the mean,
    into the piece size that minimizes the longest load (then the slot count); ``None`` otherwise."""
    if n_offsets != 2 or n_q < _FP8_MIN_ROWS:
        return None
    n_cu = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count
    bins, loads, n_slots, merges = _fp8_deal(n_q, n_heads, n_cu, None)
    if max(loads) > _SPLIT_IMBALANCE * sum(loads) / n_cu:
        bins, loads, n_slots, merges = min(
            (_fp8_deal(n_q, n_heads, n_cu, units) for units in range(2, int(max(loads)) + 1)),
            key=lambda plan: (max(plan[1]), plan[2]),
        )
    indptr, works = [0], []
    for b in bins:
        # batch, partial row (-1: write the output), query rows, key rows, keys past the piece up to the
        # tile's causal end, heads [h, h + 1)
        works += [
            [0, slot * _FP8_TILE if slot >= 0 else -1, r0, r1, k0, k1, r1 - k1, ((h + 1) << 16) | h]
            for _, h, r0, r1, k0, k1, slot in sorted(b, key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2], t[4]))
        ]
        indptr.append(len(works))
    as_tensor = functools.partial(torch.tensor, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    return (
        as_tensor(indptr),
        as_tensor(works),
        torch.arange(n_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
        torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
        n_slots,
        descriptors(merges, n_heads, _FP8_TILE, device) if merges else None,
    )


def _fp8_run(q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, sm_scale, output, plan):
    from aiter import mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd

    work_indptr, work_info, indices, one, n_slots, split = plan
    n_q, n_heads, v_dim = q.shape[0], q.shape[1], v.shape[-1]
    f8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
    qf, kf, vf = (torch.empty(x.shape, dtype=f8, device=x.device) for x in (q, k, v))
    to_fp8(n_q, q.shape[1] * q.shape[2], v.shape[1] * v.shape[2], q.device)(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf)
    # every slot the merge reads is written whole by its piece; unsplit items write ``output`` directly
    rows = max(n_slots, 1) * _FP8_TILE
    logits = torch.empty((rows, n_heads, v_dim), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    lse = torch.empty((rows, n_heads), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    mla_prefill_ps_asm_fwd(
        qf, kf, vf, cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_q, indices, work_indptr, work_info, n_q,
        float(sm_scale), True, logits, lse, output, one, one, one,
    )  # fmt: skip
    if split is not None:
        merge(split, n_heads, v_dim, rows, n_q, logits, lse, output)


def run(*, q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, qkv_fp8, cu_seqlens_k, sm_scale, output):
    from aiter.ops.mha import fmha_v3_varlen_fwd

    n_q, n_heads = q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
    fp8 = (
        _fp8_plan(n_q, n_heads, cu_seqlens_q.shape[0], q.device) if cu_seqlens_k is None and qkv_fp8 else None
    )
    if fp8 is not None:
        _fp8_run(q, k, v, cu_seqlens_q, sm_scale, output, fp8)
        return
    if cu_seqlens_k is None and cu_seqlens_q.shape[0] == 2 and n_q <= _SHORT_MAX_ROWS:
        short_attn(n_q, n_heads, q.shape[2], v.shape[2], float(sm_scale))(q, k, v, output)
        return
    v3 = _v3_plan(n_q, n_heads, cu_seqlens_q.shape[0], q.device) if cu_seqlens_k is None else None
    if v3 is not None:
        seqstart_q, seqstart_k, pad_q, pad_k, max_q = v3
        # physical offsets: every group's queries at its block's rows, its keys from the sequence start
        fmha_v3_varlen_fwd(
            q,
            k,
            v,
            seqstart_q,
            seqstart_k,
            max_q,
            n_q,
            0,
            0.0,
            float(sm_scale),
            0.0,
            False,
            True,
            -1,
            0,
            False,
            False,
            1,
            out=output,
            cu_seqlens_q_padded=pad_q,
            cu_seqlens_k_padded=pad_k,
        )
        return
    # dispatch serves one sequence (the workloads' count) in fp8, which the paths above cover at every length
    raise ValueError(f"mla_prefill_varlen: no path for {n_q} rows over {k.shape[0]} keys")

"""q, k and v rounded to float8_e4m3fn (scale 1) in one launch per 2**18 tokens: each workgroup converts the rows
of a few consecutive tokens of all three tensors."""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _rocdl_d
from flydsl.compiler import from_c_void_p
from flydsl.expr import rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

_VEC = 8  # bf16 per 16-byte load
# (tokens, threads) per workgroup: smaller workgroups up to _SMALL_ROWS tokens, to spread few tokens more
# evenly over the CUs
_SMALL, _LARGE, _SMALL_ROWS = (4, 128), (8, 256), 4096


def _rsrc(ptr, nbytes):
    """Buffer resource whose accesses past nbytes read 0 and drop stores."""
    return rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(ptr, nbytes))


def _to_fp8(val):
    """Eight bf16 rounded to e4m3fn (v_cvt_scalef32_pk_fp8_bf16, scale 1), as two dwords."""
    v = fx.Vector(val)
    one = fx.Float32(1.0).ir_value()
    words = []
    for w in range(2):
        word = fx.arith.unwrap(fx.constant_vector(0, T.vec(2, T.i16)))
        for half in range(2):
            pair = fx.arith.unwrap(v.shuffle(v, [4 * w + 2 * half, 4 * w + 2 * half + 1]))
            word = _rocdl_d.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp8_bf16(T.vec(2, T.i16), word, pair, one, bool(half))
        words.append(fx.Vector(word))
    return fx.arith.unwrap(words[0].shuffle(words[1], [0, 1, 2, 3]).bitcast(fx.Int32))


def _build(widths, rows, threads):
    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[threads, 1, 1])
    def qkv_to_fp8(
        Q: fx.Pointer, K: fx.Pointer, V: fx.Pointer, QF: fx.Pointer, KF: fx.Pointer, VF: fx.Pointer, N: fx.Int32
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bid = fx.block_idx.x
        for src, dst, w in zip((Q, K, V), (QF, KF, VF), widths):
            size = N * fx.Int32(w)
            src_rsrc = _rsrc(src, size * fx.Int32(2))
            dst_rsrc = _rsrc(dst, size)
            base = bid * (rows * w)
            offs = [base + (i * threads + tid) * _VEC for i in range(rows * w // (_VEC * threads))]
            vals = [rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(T.bf16x8, src_rsrc, off * 2, 0) for off in offs]
            for off, val in zip(offs, vals):
                rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(_to_fp8(val), dst_rsrc, off.ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value())

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        Q: fx.Pointer,
        K: fx.Pointer,
        V: fx.Pointer,
        QF: fx.Pointer,
        KF: fx.Pointer,
        VF: fx.Pointer,
        N: fx.Int32,
        blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        qkv_to_fp8(Q, K, V, QF, KF, VF, N).launch(grid=(blocks, 1, 1), block=(threads, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch


def _ptr(t, dtype):
    return from_c_void_p(dtype, t.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16)


# tokens one launch converts: its byte offsets and buffer sizes stay within int32 (2**18 rows of 12 x 192 bf16 are
# 1.2 GB)
_CHUNK_ROWS = 1 << 18


@functools.cache
def _launch(small, widths):
    """One build per workgroup shape and row widths; the token count is passed at each launch, so a length first
    seen while serving does not compile."""
    rows, threads = _SMALL if small else _LARGE
    assert all((rows * w) % (_VEC * threads) == 0 for w in widths)
    return _build(widths, rows, threads), rows


def launcher(n, qk_width, v_width, device):
    """``call(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf)`` for ``n`` tokens of q and k rows of ``qk_width`` values and v rows of
    ``v_width``, at most ``_CHUNK_ROWS`` tokens a launch."""
    launch, rows = _launch(n <= _SMALL_ROWS, (qk_width, qk_width, v_width))

    def call(q, k, v, qf, kf, vf):
        stream = fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device))
        for r0 in range(0, n, _CHUNK_ROWS):
            r1 = min(r0 + _CHUNK_ROWS, n)
            launch(
                _ptr(q[r0:r1], fx.BFloat16), _ptr(k[r0:r1], fx.BFloat16), _ptr(v[r0:r1], fx.BFloat16),
                _ptr(qf[r0:r1], fx.Float8E4M3FN), _ptr(kf[r0:r1], fx.Float8E4M3FN), _ptr(vf[r0:r1], fx.Float8E4M3FN),
                r1 - r0, -(-(r1 - r0) // rows), stream,
            )  # fmt: skip

    return call

"""Causal attention of one short sequence in one launch, bf16, every head on its own. A workgroup takes 64
query rows of one head with 8 waves: wave w owns rows 16 * (w % 4) .. +15 and key half w // 4 of every 64-key
step, so each query row's keys are walked by two waves at once; the two (max, sum, output) states are merged
through LDS at the end. K and V of a step are copied into LDS by buffer-to-LDS loads (double-buffered, one
barrier per step), issued during the previous step's MFMAs. QK is computed as S^T (A = K, B = Q^T) so a lane
holds one query row; P stays in the lane as B of O^T = V^T P^T, whose V^T operand comes from two
ds_read_b64_tr_b16 per 8 keys. Keys are walked from the diagonal down: the short blocks pull the low keys into
L2 before the long ones reach them, and only the first step of a walk, which holds the block's diagonal or
lies below it, is masked. The output is rescaled only when a step's row max exceeds the reference by more than
2^_LAZY.

The walks longer than half the longest are cut in two, as evenly as the steps allow, each half in its own
workgroup, so that the K and V of the longest walks stream through two CUs. Each wave of a half publishes its
rows' unnormalized output (bf16), max and sum (every store of the wave filling one whole KB), then swaps a
word tagged with the launch's dispatch into its rows' arrival word; the wave that finds its partner's word
there merges both, in half order, so either half writes the same bits. Nothing waits for another workgroup.
Global memory is read and written through buffer resources: rows past the sequence read 0 and are not written.
"""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _arith
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _rocdl
from flydsl.compiler import from_c_void_p
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import BFloat16, Float32, T
from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec

_GROUPS = 4  # 16-row groups per workgroup
_SPLIT = 2  # waves sharing one row group, each walking its own share of every step's keys
_PART = 32  # keys one wave takes per step
_LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
_MINIT = -1.0e20  # running max before the first key: finite, so exp2(old - new) is never inf - inf
_MASKED = -1.0e30  # a masked score: exp2 of it minus any running max is 0
_LAZY = 8.0  # log2 headroom before the reference max moves
_SC1 = 16  # cache-policy bit: device scope (write-through store, coherent load)
_FLAG_PITCH = 128  # bytes per arrival word: each on its own cache line
# odd multipliers of the launch tag (signed i64)
_TAG_H1 = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 - (1 << 64)
_TAG_H2 = 0x632BE59BD9B4E019


def _exp2(x):
    return fx.Float32(rocdl.exp2(T.f32, fx.arith.unwrap(fx.Float32(x))))


def _row_reduce(m, combine):
    """m combined over the four 16-lane rows: a permlane swap leaves every lane holding its own value in one
    result and its partner row's in the other, so combining the two needs no select."""
    pair = ir.Type.parse("!llvm.struct<(i32, i32)>")
    for swap in (_rocdl.permlane16_swap, _rocdl.permlane32_swap):
        word = _arith.bitcast(T.i32, fx.arith.unwrap(m))
        both = swap(pair, word, word, False, False)
        a, b = (fx.Float32(_arith.bitcast(T.f32, _llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, both, [i]))) for i in (0, 1))
        m = combine(a, b)
    return m


def _row_max(m):
    return _row_reduce(m, lambda a, b: a.maximumf(b))


def _i64(x):
    return _arith.constant(T.i64, x)


def _keep_branch():
    """An empty side-effecting asm: keeps a short skip body a branch instead of being if-converted."""
    _llvm.inline_asm(None, [], "", "", has_side_effects=True)


def _rsrc(ptr, nbytes):
    """Buffer resource whose accesses past nbytes read 0 and drop stores."""
    return rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(ptr, nbytes))


def _build(n_blocks, heads, dqk, dv, sm_scale):
    threads = 64 * _GROUPS * _SPLIT
    rows = 16 * _GROUPS  # query rows per workgroup
    kv_step = _PART * _SPLIT  # keys per step
    # steps are aligned to kv_step and walked from the block's last one down: with kv_step a multiple of rows
    # the first step holds the block's diagonal and every later step lies below the block's first row
    assert kv_step % rows == 0
    # buffer-to-LDS loads write a wave's 64 x 16 B contiguously, so LDS rows are unpadded and swizzled
    # instead: K's 8-element chunk c of row r sits at chunk c ^ ((r >> 1) & 7) of its group of 8, so the 16
    # rows a read touches hit 16 distinct 4-bank slots; V's 16-element block b of row r at block b ^ (r & 7),
    # so a transposed read's 4 rows hit distinct banks
    kst, vst = dqk, dv
    qst = dqk + 8  # Q's LDS row stride: 16-byte reads of 16 rows hit distinct banks
    q_chunks = 16 * (dqk // 8)  # 16-byte chunks of one row group's Q
    q_loads = q_chunks // (64 * _SPLIT)
    assert q_loads * 64 * _SPLIT == q_chunks
    kbuf, vbuf = kv_step * kst, kv_step * vst  # one buffer of each; two of each alternate between steps
    ks = dqk // 32
    dvt = dv // 16
    rq, rv = heads * dqk, heads * dv
    k_loads = kv_step * dqk // 8 // threads
    v_loads = kv_step * dv // 8 // threads
    assert k_loads * 8 * threads == kv_step * dqk and v_loads * 8 * threads == kv_step * dv
    scale = float(sm_scale) * _LOG2E
    n_cu = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device()).multi_processor_count

    def steps_of(blk):
        return -(-(blk + 1) * rows // kv_step)

    max_steps = steps_of(n_blocks - 1)

    def n_slots(t):
        return n_blocks + sum(steps_of(b) > t for b in range(n_blocks))

    # walks longer than t steps are cut in two workgroups: the smallest t whose slots still fit one round
    xcd_cap = n_cu // 8

    def xcd_load(n_sl):
        # an XCD runs its own head whole and, of a shared head, slots 4q and 4q + 1 (or 4q + 2 and 4q + 3)
        return n_sl + sum(b % 4 < 2 for b in range(n_sl))

    fits = [t for t in range(-(-max_steps // 2), max_steps + 1) if xcd_load(n_slots(t)) <= xcd_cap]
    t_cut = fits[0] if heads == 12 and fits else max_steps
    slots = n_slots(t_cut)
    n_split = slots - n_blocks
    xcd_heads = heads == 12 and xcd_load(slots) <= xcd_cap
    grid = 8 * xcd_cap if xcd_heads else slots * heads
    state = 4 * dvt + 4  # floats per lane handed over at the merge: output, then max and sum (16-byte rows)

    @fx.struct
    class Shared:
        k: fx.Array[BFloat16, 2 * kv_step * kst, 16]
        v: fx.Array[BFloat16, 2 * kv_step * vst, 16]
        q: fx.Array[BFloat16, rows * qst, 16]

    # the merge reuses K's LDS
    assert (_SPLIT - 1) * _GROUPS * 64 * state * 4 <= 2 * (kv_step * kst + kv_step * vst) * 2

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[threads, 1, 1])
    def short_causal_attn(
        Q: fx.Pointer,
        K: fx.Pointer,
        V: fx.Pointer,
        O: fx.Pointer,
        PO: fx.Pointer,
        PML: fx.Pointer,
        FL: fx.Pointer,
        N: fx.Int32,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx, _, _ = fx.block_idx
        f = fx.Int32(bx)
        if const_expr(xcd_heads):
            # workgroup f runs on XCD f % 8: XCD x takes head x whole and, of head 8 + x // 2, slots 4q + 2 (x
            # % 2) and the next one, so one XCD's L2 serves the keys and values of at most two heads and both
            # halves of a cut walk run on one XCD
            x = f % 8
            i = f // 8
            own = i < fx.Int32(slots)
            h = own.select(x, fx.Int32(8) + x // 2)
            k = i - fx.Int32(slots)
            b = own.select(i, fx.Int32(4) * (k // 2) + fx.Int32(2) * (x % 2) + k % 2)
            b = (b < fx.Int32(slots)).select(b, fx.Int32(-1))
        else:
            h = f // slots
            b = f % slots
        lane = tid % 64
        wave = tid // 64
        grp = wave % _GROUPS
        part = wave // _GROUPS
        c16 = lane % 16
        g = lane // 16
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
        kp = lds.k.ptr
        vp = lds.v.ptr
        # the sequence's N rows bound every access: a block past them reads zeros and stores nothing
        q_r, k_r, v_r = _rsrc(Q, N * fx.Int32(rq * 2)), _rsrc(K, N * fx.Int32(rq * 2)), _rsrc(V, N * fx.Int32(rv * 2))
        o_r = _rsrc(O, N * fx.Int32(rv * 2))
        n_part = max(1, heads * n_split * 2 * rows)  # rows of the cut walks' partials
        # each of a row's 4 lanes keeps the row's (max, sum), so there are 4 per row
        po_r, pml_r = _rsrc(PO, n_part * dv * 4), _rsrc(PML, n_part * 4 * 8)
        fl_bytes = max(1, heads * n_split * _GROUPS) * _FLAG_PITCH
        fl_r = _rsrc(FL, fl_bytes)

        # this lane's swizzled LDS read offsets: K chunk 4s + g of row c16 (+16 t), V^T of 4 rows from 4g +
        # c16 // 4 (+16 t)
        kx = (c16 >> 1) & 7
        k_rd = [c16 * kst + 8 * (g ^ kx), c16 * kst + 8 * ((4 + g) ^ kx)]
        vrow = 4 * g + c16 // 4
        v_rd = [vrow * vst + 16 * (d ^ (vrow & 7)) + 4 * (c16 % 4) for d in range(dvt)]

        # LDS DMA: wave w's j-th load fills 1 KB at (w * loads + j) KB of the tile, lane i its 16 B slot; the
        # slot's (row, swizzled chunk) picks the global chunk it holds
        kd_off, vd_off = [], []
        for j in range_constexpr(k_loads):
            p = (wave * k_loads + j) * 64 + lane
            row, phys = p // (dqk // 8), p % (dqk // 8)
            c = (phys // 8) * 8 + ((phys ^ ((row >> 1) & 7)) & 7)
            kd_off.append((row * rq + h * dqk + 8 * c) * 2)
        for j in range_constexpr(v_loads):
            p = (wave * v_loads + j) * 64 + lane
            row, phys = p // (dv // 8), p % (dv // 8)
            c = phys ^ ((row & 7) << 1)
            vd_off.append((row * rv + h * dv + 8 * c) * 2)
        k_lds0 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(kp))
        v_lds0 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(vp))

        def lds_ptr(base, byte_off):
            return fx.to_llvm_ptr(
                fx.inttoptr(fx.PointerType.get(T.i8, fx.AddressSpace.Shared), base + fx.Int64(byte_off))
            )

        def block(blk, st_lo, n_st, cut, half, j):
            """Block blk's rows of head h over steps st_lo .. st_lo + n_st - 1 of its walk: the step loop, the
            merge of the key shares, then the store, or for half `half` of cut walk j the publish and the
            merge with the other half."""
            q0 = blk * rows
            qrow = q0 + grp * 16 + c16
            # the row group's Q: the waves of its key shares each load a part, every load one contiguous KB of rows
            q_in = []
            for s in range_constexpr(q_loads):
                c_ = (part * q_loads + s) * 64 + lane
                row_, ch_ = c_ // (dqk // 8), c_ % (dqk // 8)
                off = ((q0 + grp * 16 + row_) * rq + h * dqk + 8 * ch_) * 2
                q_in.append((row_, ch_, rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(T.bf16x8, q_r, off, 0)))
            steps = (q0 + rows + kv_step - 1) // kv_step

            def dma_step(st, buf):
                kv0 = steps - 1 - st
                kv0 = (kv0 < fx.Int32(0)).select(fx.Int32(0), kv0) * kv_step
                for j in range_constexpr(k_loads):
                    dst = lds_ptr(k_lds0, buf * (kbuf * 2) + (wave * k_loads + j) * 1024)
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load_lds(
                        k_r, dst, fx.Int32(16), kd_off[j], kv0 * (rq * 2), fx.Int32(0), aux=0
                    )
                for j in range_constexpr(v_loads):
                    dst = lds_ptr(v_lds0, buf * (vbuf * 2) + (wave * v_loads + j) * 1024)
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load_lds(
                        v_r, dst, fx.Int32(16), vd_off[j], kv0 * (rv * 2), fx.Int32(0), aux=0
                    )

            tr_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(rocdl.cdna4.LDSReadTrans16_64b(), BFloat16)
            tr_layout = fx.make_layout(4, 1)
            k0 = part * _PART  # this wave's keys within a step

            def rescale(acc, srun, mrun, mblk):
                """Move the reference max to max(mrun, mblk) and rescale the output and the sum to it."""
                mnew = mrun.maximumf(mblk)
                alpha = _exp2(mrun - mnew)
                return [a * alpha for a in acc], srun * alpha, mnew

            def step(st, acc, mrun, srun, diagonal):
                """One step: issue the next step's loads, S^T and the softmax update for this wave's 32 keys,
                O^T += V^T P^T, stage the next step and wait for every wave."""
                acc = list(acc)
                if const_expr(not diagonal):
                    # LLVM's MFMA/DS interleave strategy 1 for this step; not in the first step, whose region holds
                    # Q's LDS stores (strategy 1 asserts on LDS stores before register allocation)
                    rocdl.iglp_opt(1)
                cur = st & fx.Int32(1)
                # in flight under this step's MFMAs, into the other buffer
                dma_step(st + 1, fx.Int32(1) - cur)
                kcur = fx.add_offset(kp, cur * kbuf + k0 * kst)
                vcur = fx.add_offset(vp, cur * vbuf + k0 * vst)
                # S^T: A = K rows (16 keys per tile), B = Q^T (16 query rows); a lane holds keys 4g..4g+3 of
                # each tile
                afr = [
                    [
                        fx.ptr_load(
                            fx.add_offset(kcur, (16 * t) * kst + 64 * (s // 2) + k_rd[s % 2]), T.bf16x8
                        )
                        for s in range(ks)
                    ]
                    for t in range(_PART // 16)
                ]
                raw = []
                for t in range_constexpr(_PART // 16):
                    sa = Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32)
                    for s in range_constexpr(ks):
                        sa = Vec(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.f32x4, [afr[t][s], qf[s], sa]))
                    raw += [fx.Float32(sa[e]) for e in range(4)]
                if const_expr(diagonal):
                    kv0 = (steps - 1 - st) * kv_step + k0
                    sv = [
                        (kv0 + 16 * (e // 4) + 4 * g + e % 4 > qrow).select(fx.Float32(_MASKED), x * scale)
                        for e, x in enumerate(raw)
                    ]
                    mblk = sv[0]
                    for x in sv[1:]:
                        mblk = mblk.maximumf(x)
                else:
                    mblk = raw[0]
                    for x in raw[1:]:
                        mblk = mblk.maximumf(x)
                    mblk = mblk * scale  # scale > 0: the max of the scaled scores
                mblk = _row_max(mblk)
                if const_expr(diagonal):
                    acc, srun, mrun = rescale(acc, srun, mrun, mblk)
                elif mblk > mrun + _LAZY:
                    # lazy rescale: the reference max moves only when this step's max is more than _LAZY
                    # (log2) above it, so P stays below 2^_LAZY; a wave skips the rescale when none of its
                    # rows needs it
                    _keep_branch()
                    acc, srun, mrun = rescale(acc, srun, mrun, mblk)
                if const_expr(diagonal):
                    pv = [_exp2(x - mrun) for x in sv]
                else:
                    neg = fx.Float32(0.0) - mrun
                    pv = [_exp2(fx.fma(x, fx.Float32(scale), neg)) for x in raw]
                psum = pv[0]
                for x in pv[1:]:
                    psum = psum + x
                srun = srun + psum  # this lane's keys only; the row's lanes are summed at the end
                # O^T += V^T P^T: B = P of the two 16-key tiles (8 keys of the lane group), A = V^T in that
                # order
                pb = Vec.from_elements(pv, Float32).to(BFloat16)
                vfr = []
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    halves = []
                    for t in range_constexpr(2):
                        elem = 16 * t * vst + v_rd[d]
                        src = fx.make_view(fx.add_offset(vcur, elem), tr_layout)
                        dst = fx.make_rmem_tensor(tr_layout, BFloat16)
                        fx.copy(tr_atom, src, dst)
                        halves.append(Vec(dst.load()))
                    vfr.append(halves[0].shuffle(halves[1], list(range(8))))
                acc = list(acc)
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    acc[d] = Vec(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.f32x4, [vfr[d], pb, acc[d]]))
                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)  # the next step's tiles have landed in LDS
                fx.barrier()
                return acc, mrun, srun

            dma_step(st_lo, st_lo & fx.Int32(1))
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
            qp = lds.q.ptr

            for row_, ch_, v8 in q_in:
                fx.ptr_store(Vec(v8), fx.add_offset(qp, (grp * 16 + row_) * qst + 8 * ch_))
            fx.barrier()
            qf = [
                fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(qp, (grp * 16 + c16) * qst + 32 * s + 8 * g), T.bf16x8)
                for s in range(ks)
            ]
            acc = [Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32) for _ in range(dvt)]
            acc, mrun, srun = step(st_lo, acc, fx.Float32(_MINIT), fx.Float32(0.0), True)
            for st in range(st_lo + 1, st_lo + n_st):
                acc, mrun, srun = step(st, acc, mrun, srun, False)

            srun = _row_reduce(srun, lambda a, b: a + b)
            # merge the key shares: waves of share p > 0 hand (max, sum, output) to the share-0 wave of their
            # row group
            sp = fx.recast_iter(Float32, kp)
            if part > fx.Int32(0):
                base = ((part - 1) * _GROUPS + grp) * 64 * state + lane * state
                fx.ptr_store(Vec.from_elements([mrun, srun], Float32), fx.add_offset(sp, base + 4 * dvt))
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    fx.ptr_store(acc[d], fx.add_offset(sp, base + 4 * d))
            fx.barrier()
            sc1 = ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, _SC1)

            def shares():
                """This lane's row over the key shares: max, the shares' weights, sum and outputs."""
                ms, ss, outs = [mrun], [srun], [acc]
                for p in range_constexpr(1, _SPLIT):
                    base = ((p - 1) * _GROUPS + grp) * 64 * state + lane * state
                    ml = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(sp, base + 4 * dvt), T.vec(2, T.f32)))
                    ms.append(fx.Float32(ml[0]))
                    ss.append(fx.Float32(ml[1]))
                    outs.append(
                        [Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(sp, base + 4 * d), T.f32x4)) for d in range(dvt)]
                    )
                top = ms[0]
                for p in range_constexpr(1, _SPLIT):
                    top = top.maximumf(ms[p])
                ws = [_exp2(m - top) for m in ms]
                tot = ss[0] * ws[0]
                for p in range_constexpr(1, _SPLIT):
                    tot = tot + ss[p] * ws[p]
                return top, ws, tot, outs

            def unnormalized(ws, outs):
                res = []
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    o = outs[0][d] * ws[0]
                    for p in range_constexpr(1, _SPLIT):
                        o = o + outs[p][d] * ws[p]
                    res.append(o)
                return res

            def store_out(vals):
                """Through this wave's 16-row bf16 tile in V's LDS (rows padded by 8 elements), so that each
                store of the wave writes four whole rows of the head."""
                ost = dv + 8
                tile = fx.recast_iter(BFloat16, vp)
                base = grp * 16 * ost
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    fx.ptr_store(vals[d].to(BFloat16), fx.add_offset(tile, base + c16 * ost + 16 * d + 4 * g))
                chunks = dv // 8  # 16-byte chunks of a row
                for k_ in range_constexpr(16 * chunks // 64):
                    row = k_ * (64 // chunks) + lane // chunks
                    ch = lane % chunks
                    v8 = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(tile, base + row * ost + 8 * ch), T.bf16x8)
                    goff = ((q0 + grp * 16 + row) * rv + h * dv + 8 * ch) * 2
                    # written through: lines left dirty in L2 are written back at the kernel's end
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(v8, o_r, goff.ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), aux=sc1)

            def finish():
                top, ws, tot, outs = shares()
                inv = fx.Float32(1.0) / tot
                vals = []
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    o = outs[0][d] * (ws[0] * inv)
                    for p in range_constexpr(1, _SPLIT):
                        o = o + outs[p][d] * (ws[p] * inv)
                    vals.append(o)
                store_out(vals)

            def wslot(hh):
                # the record of this wave in half hh: dvt / 2 KB of bf16 output, each store of the wave
                # filling one whole KB (lane i at 16 i), and 8 B of (max, sum) per lane
                return ((h * n_split + j) * 2 + hh) * _GROUPS + grp

            def rounded(own):
                """This lane's unnormalized output rounded to bf16, two 16-column groups per 16 bytes."""
                rb = [Vec(o.to(BFloat16)) for o in own]
                return [rb[2 * c].shuffle(rb[2 * c + 1], list(range(8))) for c in range(dvt // 2)]

            def publish_partial(top, tot, own):
                ws_ = wslot(half)
                for c, v8 in enumerate(rounded(own)):
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                        fx.arith.unwrap(v8), po_r, (((ws_ * (dvt // 2) + c) * 64 + lane) * 16).ir_value(),
                        fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), aux=sc1,
                    )  # fmt: skip
                rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                    Vec.from_elements([top, tot], Float32).ir_value(), pml_r,
                    ((ws_ * 64 + lane) * 8).ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), aux=sc1,
                )  # fmt: skip

            def arrive():
                """Swap the launch's tag and this half into the arrival word of this wave's rows (lane 0
                alone: every other lane's offset is out of range, so it is dropped); nonzero if the partner's
                was there."""
                did = _llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.dispatch.id", [], [], [])
                qptr = _llvm.call_intrinsic(_llvm.PointerType.get(4), "llvm.amdgcn.queue.ptr", [], [], [])
                tag = _arith.addi(
                    _arith.muli(did, _i64(_TAG_H1)), _arith.muli(_llvm.ptrtoint(T.i64, qptr), _i64(_TAG_H2))
                )
                tag = _arith.shli(tag, _i64(1))
                hv = _arith.extsi(T.i64, half.ir_value())
                word = ((h * n_split + j) * _GROUPS + grp) * _FLAG_PITCH
                aoff = (lane == fx.Int32(0)).select(word, fx.Int32(fl_bytes))
                old = _llvm.call_intrinsic(
                    T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.raw.ptr.buffer.atomic.swap.i64",
                    [_arith.ori(tag, hv), fl_r, aoff.ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                     fx.Int32(0).ir_value()],
                    [], [],
                )  # fmt: skip
                want = _arith.ori(tag, _arith.xori(hv, _i64(1)))
                hit = fx.Int32(_arith.extui(T.i32, _arith.cmpi(_arith.CmpIPredicate.eq, old, want)))
                return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, hit.ir_value()))

            def merge(top, tot, own):
                """The last half: this half's and the partner's partials, summed in half order so either half
                merges to the same bits."""
                ws_ = wslot(fx.Int32(1) - half)
                mlp = Vec(
                    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(T.vec(2, T.f32), pml_r, (ws_ * 64 + lane) * 8, 0, aux=_SC1)
                )
                oth = []
                for c in range_constexpr(dvt // 2):
                    v8 = Vec(
                        rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                            T.bf16x8, po_r, ((ws_ * (dvt // 2) + c) * 64 + lane) * 16, 0, aux=_SC1
                        )
                    )
                    oth += [
                        v8.shuffle(v8, [0, 1, 2, 3]).to(Float32),
                        v8.shuffle(v8, [4, 5, 6, 7]).to(Float32),
                    ]
                mine = []
                for v8 in rounded(own):
                    mine += [
                        v8.shuffle(v8, [0, 1, 2, 3]).to(Float32),
                        v8.shuffle(v8, [4, 5, 6, 7]).to(Float32),
                    ]
                mp, lp = fx.Float32(mlp[0]), fx.Float32(mlp[1])
                big = top.maximumf(mp)
                w_own, w_p = _exp2(top - big), _exp2(mp - big)
                is0 = half == fx.Int32(0)
                t_own, t_p = tot * w_own, lp * w_p
                inv = fx.Float32(1.0) / (is0.select(t_own, t_p) + is0.select(t_p, t_own))
                vals = []
                for d in range_constexpr(dvt):
                    a, b2 = mine[d] * w_own, oth[d] * w_p
                    vals.append((is0.select(a, b2) + is0.select(b2, a)) * inv)
                store_out(vals)

            def cut_walk():
                """Each wave of a half publishes its rows' partial, then swaps; the later one merges them,
                both halves' outputs as published (bf16), so either half writes the same bits."""
                top, ws, tot, outs = shares()
                own = unnormalized(ws, outs)
                publish_partial(top, tot, own)
                rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
                if arrive() != fx.Int32(0):
                    merge(top, tot, own)

            if part == fx.Int32(0):
                if cut:
                    cut_walk()
                else:
                    finish()

        # slot b of a head: the two halves of each cut walk side by side, longest first, then the uncut
        # blocks, longest first
        if b >= fx.Int32(0):
            cut = b < fx.Int32(2 * n_split)
            half = cut.select(b % 2, fx.Int32(0))
            j = b // 2
            blk = cut.select(fx.Int32(n_blocks - 1) - j, fx.Int32(n_blocks - 1 + n_split) - b)
            n_all = (blk * rows + rows + kv_step - 1) // kv_step
            # a cut walk is halved as evenly as the steps allow, the first half taking the odd one
            t_hi = (n_all + fx.Int32(1)) // 2
            st_lo = (half == fx.Int32(1)).select(t_hi, fx.Int32(0))
            n_st = cut.select((half == fx.Int32(0)).select(t_hi, n_all - st_lo), n_all)
            block(blk, st_lo, n_st, cut, half, j)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        Q: fx.Pointer, K: fx.Pointer, V: fx.Pointer, O: fx.Pointer, PO: fx.Pointer, PML: fx.Pointer,
        FL: fx.Pointer, N: fx.Int32, stream: fx.Stream,
    ):  # fmt: skip
        short_causal_attn(Q, K, V, O, PO, PML, FL, N).launch(
            grid=(grid, 1, 1), block=(threads, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch, max(1, heads * n_split * 2 * rows), max(1, heads * n_split * _GROUPS) * _FLAG_PITCH


# one build per 64-row block count, the row count passed at each launch: a sequence length first seen while
# serving does not compile
_compiled = functools.cache(_build)


def launcher(n, heads, dqk, dv, sm_scale):
    """``call(q, k, v, out)``: causal attention of one sequence of ``n`` tokens, q/k rows of ``heads * dqk``
    and v/out rows of ``heads * dv`` bf16 values."""
    launch, n_part, fl_bytes = _compiled(-(-n // (16 * _GROUPS)), heads, dqk, dv, sm_scale)

    def ptr(t, dtype=fx.BFloat16):
        return from_c_void_p(dtype, t.data_ptr(), assumed_align=16)

    def call(q, k, v, out):
        # the cut walks' partials and arrival words: rewritten before they are read, and a word counts only
        # with this launch's tag
        po = torch.empty(n_part * dv, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
        pml = torch.empty(n_part * 4 * 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
        fl = torch.empty(fl_bytes // 4, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
        launch(
            ptr(q), ptr(k), ptr(v), ptr(out), ptr(po, fx.Float32), ptr(pml, fx.Float32), ptr(fl, fx.Int32), n,
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)),
        )  # fmt: skip

    return call

"""Merge of the fp8 prefill's split key walks: each split query tile's output rows are the LSE-weighted mean
of its pieces' fp32 partial outputs, merged in piece order, rounded to bf16.

The tiles come as descriptor rows at each launch, one build per most pieces a tile has, so a sequence length
first seen while serving does not compile. Split tile s has the row [out_base, n_rows, n_splits, p_0 .. p_{MS-1}]
with out_base = its first row * H, n_rows = its rows * H and p_j = the first partial row of piece j * H (padded
with p_0). Row x of the tile (x = local row * H + h) merges partial rows p_j + x by their natural-log lse, in j
order, into out_base + x."""

import functools
import math

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

_LOG2E = math.log2(math.e)
_VEC = 4  # fp32 values per lane: one 16-byte load
_THREADS = 256
_DESC_HEAD = 3


def _view(ptr, dtype, shape, stride):
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(fx.make_view(fx.recast_iter(dtype, ptr), fx.make_layout(shape, stride)))


@functools.cache
def _compile(max_splits: int, v_dim: int):
    ms, stride = max_splits, _DESC_HEAD + max_splits
    lanes = v_dim // _VEC
    rows_per_block = _THREADS // lanes

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[_THREADS, 1, 1])
    def merge_split_rows(
        part: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P, v_dim] (P = partial rows * H)
        lse: fx.Pointer,  # f32 [P]
        desc: fx.Pointer,  # i32 [n_tiles, stride]
        out: fx.Pointer,  # bf16 [R, v_dim]
        n_part: fx.Int32,
        n_out: fx.Int32,
        n_tiles: fx.Int32,
    ):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx = fx.block_idx.x
        by = fx.block_idx.y
        x = bx * fx.Int32(rows_per_block) + tid // fx.Int32(lanes)
        lane = tid % fx.Int32(lanes)

        g_desc = _view(desc, fx.Int32, (n_tiles * fx.Int32(stride),), (1,))
        g_part = _view(part, fx.Float32, (n_part, v_dim), (v_dim, 1))
        g_lse = _view(lse, fx.Float32, (n_part,), (1,))
        g_out = _view(out, fx.BFloat16, (n_out, v_dim), (v_dim, 1))

        base = by * fx.Int32(stride)
        out_base = g_desc[base]
        n_rows = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(1)]
        n_splits = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(2)]
        # the grid is as wide as the widest tile: a row past this tile's stores nothing
        if x < n_rows:
            reg_layout = fx.make_layout(_VEC, 1)
            atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), fx.Float32)
            neg_inf = fx.Float32(float("-inf"))
            lses, parts = [], []
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(ms):
                prow = g_desc[base + fx.Int32(_DESC_HEAD + j)] + x
                l = g_lse[prow]
                if j >= 1:  # a tile of fewer pieces pads with its first: weigh the copies 0
                    l = (fx.Int32(j) < n_splits).select(l, neg_inf)
                lses.append(l)
                tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_part, (prow, None)), reg_layout)
                frag = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.Float32)
                fx.copy_atom_call(atom, fx.slice(tiled, (None, lane)), frag)
                parts.append(frag.load())

            m = lses[0]
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(1, ms):
                m = m.maximumf(lses[j])
            zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
            m = (m > neg_inf).select(m, zero)
            acc = [zero for _ in fx.range_constexpr(_VEC)]
            den = zero
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(ms):
                w = fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(T.f32, ((lses[j] - m) * _LOG2E).ir_value()))
                den = den + w
                v = parts[j]
                acc = [acc[i] + w * v[i] for i in fx.range_constexpr(_VEC)]
            inv = fx.Float32((den > zero).select(fx.rocdl.rcp(T.f32, den.ir_value()), zero))

            res = fx.make_rmem_tensor(reg_layout, fx.BFloat16)
            res.store(
                fx.Vector.from_elements([(acc[i] * inv).to(fx.BFloat16) for i in fx.range_constexpr(_VEC)],
                                        dtype=fx.BFloat16)
            )  # fmt: skip
            out_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy64b(), fx.BFloat16)
            out_tiled = fx.logical_divide(fx.slice(g_out, (out_base + x, None)), reg_layout)
            fx.copy_atom_call(out_atom, res, fx.slice(out_tiled, (None, lane)))

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        part: fx.Pointer, lse: fx.Pointer, desc: fx.Pointer, out: fx.Pointer,
        n_part: fx.Int32, n_out: fx.Int32, n_tiles: fx.Int32, n_blocks: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None),  # noqa: B008
    ):  # fmt: skip
        merge_split_rows(part, lse, desc, out, n_part, n_out, n_tiles).launch(
            grid=(n_blocks, n_tiles, 1), block=(_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch, rows_per_block


def descriptors(tiles, n_heads, slot_rows, device):
    """For split tiles ``((first row, rows, (slot, ...)), ...)``, where slot ``s`` holds rows ``[s * slot_rows,
    s * slot_rows + rows)`` of the partial buffers: the descriptor rows on the device, the most pieces a tile has
    and the most rows."""
    ms = max(len(slots) for _, _, slots in tiles)
    desc = []
    for r0, rows, slots in tiles:
        ps = [s * slot_rows * n_heads for s in slots]
        desc += [r0 * n_heads, rows * n_heads, len(slots)] + ps + [ps[0]] * (ms - len(ps))
    return torch.tensor(desc, dtype=torch.int32, device=device), ms, max(rows for _, rows, _ in tiles)


def merge(split, n_heads, v_dim, partial_rows, out_rows, partial_out, partial_lse, out):
    """Merge the split tiles ``split`` (``descriptors``' result) of the partial buffers into ``out``."""
    desc, ms, max_rows = split
    launch, rows_per_block = _compile(ms, v_dim)
    ptr = lambda t, d: flyc.from_c_void_p(d, t.data_ptr())  # noqa: E731
    launch(
        ptr(partial_out, fx.Float32), ptr(partial_lse, fx.Float32), ptr(desc, fx.Int32), ptr(out, fx.BFloat16),
        partial_rows * n_heads, out_rows * n_heads, desc.numel() // (_DESC_HEAD + ms),
        -(-max_rows * n_heads // rows_per_block), fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(out.device)),
    )  # fmt: skip
